approved_source_coverage_gaps.detail: No direct Football-Data.co.uk CSV exists (only divisions E0/SP1/I1/D1/F1/N1/P1), soccerdata's FBref league dictionary exposes no Champions League/Europa League/Nations League entries (only INT-World Cup and INT-European Championship), LEAGUE_TO_SD_MH_CODE has no entries for these ids, and the Sofascore route is the only approved source left - which returns HTTP 403 from this environment.
approved_source_coverage_gaps.consequence: These competition-seasons cannot acquire historical fixtures through any currently reachable approved source and must remain INCOMPLETE with that exact reason.
approved_source_coverage_gaps.corrective_action: Either restore a reachable Sofascore route, extend FBref/MatchHistory mappings where the upstream library supports them, or approve an additional verified source for these competitions.
